content: ## Try your first agent task {% action-card title="Build your first app with an agent" %} Build and validate a small app, then review the result. The quickstart uses the {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %} harness with recommended defaults, so you don't need to configure every option first. * [Start the agents quickstart](/docs/agents/quickstart.md) {% /action-card %} * **Already use agents:** Follow the [experienced-agent fast track](/docs/agents/guides/overview.md#experienced-agent-fast-track) in your own repository. * **New to {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}:** First [install the editor and open a workspace](/docs/getstarted/overview.md).
